provenance: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 native CSV/XLSX compiler token boundaries. Adjacent cell endpoints form one token; a trailing single cell can fold after token insertion. At most 8191 stored tokens precede the stop token. Unrelated deep arithmetic evaluation limits are not covered by these compiler controls.
